proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CUSTOMER DUE DILIGENCE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report assessing Amazon's customer due diligence process to determine whether customer use of surveillance or cloud products contributes to human rights violations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer due diligence.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A MANDATORY INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR POLICY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director who has not previously served as an executive officer of the Company.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a mandatory independent board chair policy.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON GENDER/RACIAL PAY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on gender/racial pay.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON PROMOTION DATA
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report disclosing promotion velocity rates by title and level for different gender and racial identities.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on promotion data.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON PACKAGING MATERIALS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on plastic packaging estimating plastic released to the environment and describing strategies or goals to reduce plastic packaging.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on packaging materials.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A DIVERSITY AND EQUITY AUDIT REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a racial equity audit analyzing Amazon's impacts on civil rights, equity, diversity and inclusion, and effects on its business, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a diversity and equity audit report.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ALTERNATIVE DIRECTOR CANDIDATE POLICY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy that the initial list of director candidates include hourly Associates to promote employee perspectives on the board.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an alternative director candidate policy.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON COMPETITION STRATEGY AND RISK
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how the board oversees risks related to anticompetitive practices and its role in related public policy activities.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on competition strategy and risk.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ADDITIONAL REDUCTION IN THRESHOLD FOR CALLING SPECIAL SHAREHOLDER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests lowering the ownership threshold to call a special shareholder meeting from 25% to 20% of outstanding common stock.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an additional reduction in threshold for calling special shareholder meetings.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON LOBBYING
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing lobbying policies, payments including trade association and grassroots lobbying, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on lobbying.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CUSTOMER USE OF CERTAIN TECHNOLOGIES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent study of Rekognition's privacy, civil rights, and human rights risks, including sales to repressive governments, with a report by September 2021.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer use of certain technologies.
